claimed.subject: AI reliability work at UpLayer
claimed.body:
Hi UpLayer team,

Your AI Engineer role puts retrieval quality, guardrails, and fallbacks inside the shipped product rather than treating them as later fixes. That is the kind of engineering I enjoy.

I built Captor to add per-call LLM budgets, policies, and traces, and at Stride AI I owned backend APIs alongside frontend features. My experience is around three years including internships, below the four years listed, but the problems in this role are ones I've been working on directly.

Would you consider my work for the AI Engineer opening despite that gap?

Portfolio: https://devansh.aurat.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/8dazo

Devansh
